title: The lost wallet and the car key

cues.text: You come into Bookworms. Bunkichi and Mitsuko are searching the shop, peering around the floor.
You join in, and the three of you go over the whole shop.
The shop door opens and a young foreign man walks in. He comes up to Bunkichi and holds out a wallet.
Bebe walks out of the shop.
Bunkichi bends low over the open wallet and digs through it.
Bunkichi shuffles up to you, bowing over the wallet in his hands.
